_comment: Static Pokemon GO reference data. baseStats is imported directly from PvPoke's public gamemaster.json (https://github.com/pvpoke/pvpoke/blob/master/src/data/gamemaster.json), filtered to released, non-Shadow/Mega/Gmax/Primal/Purified species+forms (1045 entries covering the full Pokedex as of this import), with duplicate-stat cosmetic variants (e.g. costume Pikachu) collapsed to one canonical entry per dex number. Each entry's "family" block (id/parent/evolutions) also comes straight from PvPoke's gamemaster, so evolution-line lookups need no external API call. CP multipliers are Niantic's official per-level values; half-levels are derived with Niantic's documented formula sqrt((cpm[n]^2 + cpm[n+1]^2) / 2). displayNameAliases covers the handful of species whose PvPoke display name doesn't normalize back to its own speciesId (e.g. "Zygarde (50% Forme)").

attackerRankings.dpsFileNote: Global raid-attacker DPS/TDO/ER ranking across all species and forms (including Mega/Shadow). Used both as-is (overall rank) and re-grouped per type (rank within all attackers sharing a Type1/Type2 with this species) to answer 'is X a top-N TYPE attacker'. Re-export and drop in under this same filename to refresh - the date in a freshly downloaded file's own name doesn't matter, only the filename on disk.
attackerRankings.tierFileNote: Community attacker tier list (SSSSS down to F) spanning all species/forms. Independent source from dpsFile; only cross-referenced by Pokemon name, not by rank.

littleCup.label: Little Cup
littleCup.note: Traditionally restricted to Pokemon that have not reached their final evolution. This app still reports the optimal 500 CP build for every family member and flags eligibility separately.

greatLeague.label: Great League
greatLeague.note: Standard GO Battle League cup, open ruleset.

summerLeague.label: Summer League
summerLeague.note: Seasonal cup that shares the 1500 CP cap with Great League. Any additional type/species restrictions for the live seasonal cup are not modeled here.

ultraLeague.label: Ultra League
ultraLeague.note: Standard GO Battle League cup, open ruleset.

masterLeague.label: Master League
masterLeague.note: No CP cap. Optimal build is always 15/15/15 at the highest available level.
